court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court No.6, Mumbai in Petition No.Civil M.A.-237 of 2015
facts_of_case: Petitioner-husband instituted petition for divorce under Sections 13(1)(ia) and 13(1)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The petition was dismissed in default. Application for restoration was filed after more than two years from the date of dismissal.

legal_principles.principle: An application for restoration of a dismissed petition must be filed within a reasonable time.
legal_principles.held: Instead of dismissing the application, the learned trial Judge rejected the application principally on the ground that no sufficient cause was made out in the application which was filed after two years of date of dismissal of the petition.

legal_principles.principle: A petitioner seeking restoration of a dismissed petition must demonstrate sufficient cause for the delay.
legal_principles.held: By the impugned order, the learned trial Judge rejected the application principally on the ground that no sufficient cause was made out in the application which was filed after two years of date of dismissal of the petition.

outcome.final_order: Petition No.A-542/2008 is restored to its original position. The learned trial Judge will issue notice to the respondent and thereafter proceed with the matter in accordance with law.

use_for_drafting: drafting a writ petition for divorce
